webview2.sdk_adapter: workspace/runtime/webview2-sdk unless a sealed runtime/webview2-sdk is present
webview2.evergreen_fallback: allowed but recorded as external runtime dependency

reproducibility.mutable_workspace: excluded from application seal; snapshot separately
reproducibility.fixed_webview2_requirement: Full browser-engine binary reproducibility requires a pinned fixed-version runtime in the fixed runtime slot. Evergreen fallback is portable-state-safe but not binary-identical across machines.

ui_state.coordinate_model: normalized 0..1 x/y for portable cross-window-size placement
